import { Box, TextField, Typography, Button, FormGroup, FormControlLabel, Checkbox } from "@mui/material";
import Scene from "./components/Scene";

export default function Login() {
    return (
        <Box
            display="flex"
            justifyContent="center"
            alignItems="center"
            height="100vh"
            width="100vw"
            style={{
                margin: 0,
                padding: 0,
                position: "fixed",
                top: 0,
                left: 0,
            }}
        >
            <Box
                position="absolute"
                top={0}
                left={0}
                width="100%"
                height="100%"
                zIndex={-1}
            >
                <Scene />
            </Box>
            <Box
                bgcolor="rgba(255, 255, 255, 1.0)"
                borderRadius="8px"
                padding="40px"
                boxShadow="0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)"
                textAlign="center"
                width="90%"
                maxWidth="400px"
                style={{
                    backdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
                    WebkitBackdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
                }}
            >
                <Typography fontWeight="bold" fontSize="25px" mb="30px">
                    VSpaceへログイン
                </Typography>
                <TextField
                    id="email"
                    label="Email"
                    variant="outlined"
                    fullWidth
                    style={{ marginBottom: "15px" }}
                />
                <TextField
                    id="password"
                    label="Password"
                    variant="outlined"
                    fullWidth
                    style={{ marginBottom: "15px" }}
                    type="password"
                />
                <FormGroup style={{ marginBottom: "15px" }}>
                    <FormControlLabel
                        control={<Checkbox />}
                        label="自動ログイン"
                    />
                </FormGroup>
                <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    fullWidth
                    style={{ padding: "15px", backgroundColor: "black", color: "white" }}
                >
                    ログイン
                </Button>
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}
